LESSON: KUSOMA 5.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAJUKUMU YA KIJINSIA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za U
Topic 5.2: Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
3. Practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 5.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU
This lesson teaches Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu for Grade 8 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu above.
2. Explain Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu
3. Practise Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu at school and at home

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

5.2 Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma

kwa Ufahamu

(Vipindi 2)

Kufikia mwisho wa

mada ndogo,

mwanafunzi aweze:

a) kudondoa habari

mahususi katika

kifungu cha

ufahamu,

b) kueleza maana ya

msamiati kulingan
